title: What happens to mathematics when AI becomes an oracle?
original_title: What happens to mathematics when AI becomes an oracle?
summary: Mathematician Steven Strogatz discusses his new book, Big Math: The Hidden Codes That Run Our World.
title_zh: 数学家讨论人工智能成为神谕之后
lead_zh: Ars Technica 介绍 Strogatz 与 Townsend 的新书《Big Math》，讨论算法、预报、医学成像和机器学习背后的数学，以及大模型可能让数学超出创造者掌控。
